title: fix(build): ESLint compatibility + classifier false positives
head: bb/mvp1.6-deploy-final
body:
## Summary
Fixes Next.js 15 ESLint compatibility issues and classifier false positives.

## Changes
1. **next.config.mjs**: Disable ESLint during Next.js build
   - Next.js 15 has compatibility issues with flat config (eslint.config.js)
   - ESLint still runs separately via pnpm lint
   - Fixes: Unknown options: useEslintrc, extensions error

2. **scripts/pr-scrape.ts**: Fix classifier false positives
   - Exclude quality gate passed from CRITICAL classification
   - Prevents SonarCloud success messages from being flagged as critical

## Verification
- ✅ pnpm audit: 0 vulnerabilities
- ✅ pnpm build: Compiled successfully
- ✅ pnpm lint: Works (560 warnings, 3 errors - pre-existing)
- ✅ pnpm run pr:scrape 60: 0 CRITICAL (was incorrectly flagging Sonar)
- ✅ Docstring coverage: 94.06%

## Related
- PR #63 (already fixed swcMinify + scripts TS errors)
- PR #62 (added dotenv config to scripts)
